name: Jingting Hotel
aiSummary: Review summary Powered by AI Hygiene:Most users praise that the rooms and the environment are clean. The yard, tables and chairs, and swimming pool are cleaned regularly. Service:The owners are very enthusiastic and considerate. The service attitude is good, and they are very welcoming. Facilities:There are advanced facilities, such as central air conditioning. There is also a swimming pool which is very popular among children. Activities:There are rich activities like picking tea, digging bamboo shoots, etc. according to different seasons
address: No. 17 Fenshuiling, Lanshukeng, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
